desc:
[GOAL] 500 Likes for Area 51!! 👽🐄🛸

Cause chaos in a living city with realistic ragdoll physics, then try to escape the cops! 🚓💥

🧍 REALISTIC RAGDOLLS: every hit gets a reaction. People stagger, grab their wounds, limp, fall and tumble.
🔫 25+ WEAPONS: pistols, Uzis, AKs, bats, katanas, a gravity hammer, grenades, molotovs and wild fun tools like the Freeze Ray and Push Gun.
🚗 CARS: drive a lowrider, muscle car, pickup, ice cream truck, school bus and more. Send people flying!
⭐ WANTED LEVEL: the more chaos you cause, the more stars you get. Cops, police cruisers, roadblocks and SWAT come for you. Escape for bonus cash!
💣 CHAOS EVENTS: call in an Airstrike, a Mega Bomb or a Crowd Drop for the whole server.

Play solo or join a multiplayer server with up to 6 players.
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to follow new updates!
